channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why has the US sanctioned Iraq’s deputy oil minister for helping Iran?
item.description: The US accuses Ali Maarij al-Bahadly of helping Iran avoid sanctions and export its oil through Iraq.

item.title: Lebanon Latest Israeli strikes Beirut despite ‘ceasefire’
item.description: Israel has carried out its first airstrike on Beirut’s southern suburbs since the April 16 US-brokered ceasefire.

item.title: Iran’s president says he has spoken to the country’s Supreme Leader
item.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian says he has met with Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

item.title: Iran’s President Pezeshkian seeks to quash divided leadership narrative
item.description: Tehran emphasises solidarity among top officials as Washington pressures Iran during Strait of Hormuz disputes.

item.title: US-Israel war on Iran leaves Jordan’s Petra nearly empty of tourists
item.description: Middle East war devastates tourism in Petra, leaving sites empty and Jordanians facing severe loss of income.

item.title: Why is the US seeking UN help to open Hormuz after undermining it?
item.description: Marco Rubio has called on the UN for a Hormuz solution as talks for a peace deal in Iran continue.

item.title: Fears of renewed Gaza war as Hamas disarmament talks stall
item.description: Israeli media reports suggest Israel is preparing to resume fighting because of the impasse in talks with Hamas.

item.title: Iran considering US proposal as Trump says war will be 'over quickly'
item.description: Mediator Pakistan says it is "endeavouring to convert this ceasefire into a permanent end to this war".

item.title: 'My heart is in a million pieces': Vigils in Australia for five-year-old allegedly killed in Outback
item.description: Kumanjayi Little Baby was found dead after going missing from an Aboriginal town camp in Alice Springs.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut for first time since Hezbollah ceasefire
item.description: Israel says it targeted a senior Hezbollah figure in the capital, the first strike of its kind since mid-April.
